# Deskforge repository instructions

Read and obey `/AGENTS.md` before proposing or editing code. Treat it as the authoritative contract for scope, A-UI visual fidelity, Deskforge branding, React/IPC/SQLite boundaries, protected “正在开发中” features, testing, user-data safety, and documentation maintenance.

When a persistent rule changes, update `/AGENTS.md` and the relevant `/docs` records instead of copying divergent rules into this file.
